buyBody: Gold flecked across the shirt like it was thrown at it. The loudest print in the Classic range and the one that most obviously belongs to a brand whose clubs are gold.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body, with a gold club in frame. The whole shot is the rhyme between the flecks and the finish on the club.
